Thus from the two events we scored 11 points out of a possible 12, and a continuance of this form will keep us at the head of the table. There were two club handicaps at this meeting and in the 100 yards the winner of the final was F.

Francis Skelley, now recovered from his accident and stationed somewhere in Kent, and would like to hear from some of his old Club friends. " Quack," out in " the States," still has time to write to England and sends a ponderous sports programme more like a general store catalogue.

Dereck equalled the Club junior record for the high jump with a height of 5'8" at the Club championships, he also won the senior long jump with a distance of 21'11" beating the existing Junior record of 21'6½" held by F.
